newsitem.title: USA: Circus's Luxor opens addition to hotel.
newsitem.headline: Circus's Luxor opens addition to hotel.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprise Inc's Luxor hotel and casino on Thursday officially opened the first phase of its $300 million expansion to add rooms and new amenities to the pyramid-shaped resort.
The expansion includes 1,900 new rooms, including 237 suites, bringing the total room count to 4,427 and making the hotel the second largest in the United States, Luxor said in a statement.
The current hotels' interior was re-designed to include a replica of an Egyptian temple and relocated registration desk. A 20,000 square foot convention hall was also added.
Construction began in January 1996. Phase II of the expansion is scheduled for completion in the fall with the addition of two new restaurants and an 18-store retail plaza.
Finally, the Luxor also plans to add an Egyptian-themed, state-of-the-art movie theater.
